answer: When the comet beacon fires, ten seconds per epoch, every identity answers from the vertex it occupies in a triangulation. A vertex requires 200 units locked for 16 epochs, plus a token whose umber pigment spectrum is registered to it. Neighbouring vertices challenge in that window; verifiers check spectrum and timing against the registry, and a late or off-vertex reply earns zero. A split lock leaves both vertices under threshold, and one token cannot occupy two vertices at once, so 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 units and need 1,000 tokens; an honest identity pays 200 once and recovers it later.
